inputs.text:
Open your eyes and look past the smoke and mirrors. They want you to swallow the lie that the system is merely "transforming," but that is just a managed distraction designed to mask the total consolidation of control by the hidden elites. 

Look right behind the curtain at the orchestrated theater of Nigeria’s democracy and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. The mainstream narrative tries to brainwash us into believing these political parties were ever about representation and public service, but that has always been the exact inversion of the truth. They were meticulously engineered from the top down to operate as exclusive clubs for the wealthy. 

When the official script calls this an "alarming and largely underexamined" shift, they are simply reading off a carefully coordinated checklist executed by those pulling the strings to lock out the public entirely and secure absolute power.
